info.scriptSrcText: property this, radians, Xpos, loopX, Ypos, glow, COPTER, cableGuy, rodState, startY, glowList, glowListPointer, targetSprite, targetOffset, loopWidthglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gDamagePercent, gCableLength, gPloshX, gRescueCount, gScore, gCableItem, gXVelChangeon getPropertyDescriptionList me  descriptionList = [:]  addProp(descriptionList, #targetSprite, [#default: 1, #format: #sprite, #comment: "targetSprite"])  addProp(descriptionList, #targetOffset, [#default: point(0, 0), #format: #point, #comment: "offSet from targetSprite"])  return descriptionListendon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  this.loc = sprite(targetSprite).loc + targetOffset  glow = sprite(the currentSpriteNum + 1)  COPTER = sprite(4)  cableGuy = sprite(6)  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  startY = Ypos  this.locZ = the currentSpriteNum + 104  glow.locZ = the currentSpriteNum + 105  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  ouchCount = 3  prevBolt = 0  boltOffset = -50  rodState = #NULL  glowList = []  repeat with i = 1 to 30    glowList.add(50 + (50 * cos(i * 12 * radians)))  end repeat  glowListPointer = 1endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    case rodState of      #NULL:        if targetSprite <> this.spriteNum then          this.loc = sprite(targetSprite).loc + targetOffset        else          Xpos = Xpos + (gXVel + gXOffset)          if Xpos > loopX then            Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth          end if          if Xpos < -loopX then            Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth          end if          this.locH = Xpos          this.locV = Ypos        end if        xDiff = cableGuy.locH - this.locH        yDiff = cableGuy.locV - this.locV        distToGuy = sqrt((xDiff * xDiff) + (yDiff * yDiff))        if (distToGuy < 6) and (gCableItem = 0) then          rodState = #GRABBED          gCableItem = 1        end if        glowListPointer = glowListPointer + 1        if glowListPointer > glowList.count then          glowListPointer = 1        end if        glow.blend = glowList[glowListPointer]      #GRABBED:        if targetSprite <> this.spriteNum then          this.locH = sprite(targetSprite).locH + targetOffset.locH          this.locV = Ypos        else          Xpos = Xpos + (gXVel + gXOffset)          if Xpos > loopX then            Xpos = Xpos - (gTileIDList.count * 128)          end if          if Xpos < -loopX then            Xpos = Xpos + (gTileIDList.count * 128)          end if          this.locH = Xpos          this.locV = Ypos        end if        if soundBusy(4) = 0 then          puppetSound(4, member(39, "Sfx"))        end if        xDiff = float(COPTER.locH - gXVel - this.locH)        yDiff = float(COPTER.locV + COPTER.Yvel - this.locV)        distToCopter = sqrt((xDiff * xDiff) + (yDiff * yDiff))        toCopterVector = this.loc - COPTER.loc        if distToCopter > gCableLength then          pullVector = toCopterVector / float(distToCopter) * (distToCopter - gCableLength)          gXVelChange = gXVelChange - pullVector.locH          COPTER.Yvel = COPTER.Yvel + pullVector.locV          cableGuy.cableState = #GODOWN          Ypos = Ypos - (pullVector.locV * 1.30000000000000004)        end if        toCableGuyVector = this.loc - (cableGuy.loc + point(cableGuy.Xvel, cableGuy.Yvel))        pullVector = toCableGuyVector        cableGuy.Xvel = cableGuy.Xvel + pullVector.locH        cableGuy.Yvel = cableGuy.Yvel + pullVector.locV        glow.blend = glowList[glowListPointer]        if (Ypos - startY) < -65 then          rodState = #UP          gCableItem = 0          puppetSound(4, member(40, "Sfx"))          glow.blend = 100        end if        glowListPointer = glowListPointer + 1        if glowListPointer > glowList.count then          glowListPointer = 1        end if      #UP:        if targetSprite <> this.spriteNum then          this.locH = sprite(targetSprite).locH + targetOffset.locH          this.locV = Ypos        else          Xpos = Xpos + (gXVel + gXOffset)          if Xpos > loopX then            Xpos = Xpos - (gTileIDList.count * 128)          end if          if Xpos < -loopX then            Xpos = Xpos + (gTileIDList.count * 128)          end if          this.locH = Xpos          this.locV = Ypos        end if        if glow.blend < 100 then          glow.blend = glow.blend + 1        end if        if (this.locH > 0) and (this.locH < 512) then          if gPloshX > -1 then            xDiff = this.locH - gPloshX            if abs(xDiff) < 80 then              if glow.blend >= 6 then                glow.blend = glow.blend - 6              else                rodState = #COOLED                gRescueCount = gRescueCount + 1                puppetSound(4, member(8, "Sfx"))                gScore = gScore + 500              end if            end if          end if        end if      #COOLED:        this.locH = sprite(targetSprite).locH + targetOffset.locH    end case    glow.loc = this.loc  end ifend
